heard: To keep the world alive, the Empire plunged itself into total darkness. Every hearthfire across the Aztec realm was extinguished before midnight. Parents kept children awake all night to prevent them from turning into mice. High atop the hill of the star, priests watched the Pleiades. Priests cut open a captive's chest to kindle a new flame. Relay runners carried torches across the valley to relight the civilization. To keep the world alive, the Empire plunged itself into total darkness.
